items_flat.title_en: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon generally available
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced on Nov 10 that Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest frontier model for long-horizon agentic work, cybersecurity, coding and scientific reasoning, is now available to paying developers via the Gemini API in AI Studio and Gemini for business, and rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app, AI Mode and Antigravity, at introductory $2/$10 per million tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google於11月10日宣布，其最強前沿模型Gemini 4 Carbon（擅長長時程代理工作、網路安全、編碼與科學推理）現已向付費開發者透過Gemini API開放，並逐步向Google AI Ultra訂閱者推出於Gemini App、AI Mode與Antigravity，入門價格為每百萬token 2/10美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Carbon’s broader release strengthens Google’s position in high-stakes agentic and cyber workflows at competitive introductory pricing, but sustained performance versus rivals and post-November pricing will determine real adoption.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Carbon更廣泛釋出強化Google在高風險代理與資安工作流程的競爭力與入門定價，但長期表現對比對手及11月後定價將決定實際採用程度。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re making Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers. Carbon is our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity capabilities and long-horizon agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將Gemini 4 Carbon開放給開發者、企業、科學家與消費者。Carbon是我們最強的模型，在網路安全能力與長時程代理工作流程上具有前沿表現。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic advances IPO roadshow with $70–$78 price range
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic推進IPO路演，價格區間70至78美元
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s IPO roadshow continued on Nov 12, with the company linking to its offering site. Updated filings set a $70–$78 range for 825 million Class A shares (ticker ANT), implying up to roughly $1.4 trillion fully diluted valuation and up to ~$64 billion raised, plus a concurrent ~$26 billion private placement from Google, Nvidia and other chip/cloud partners; trading expected around Nov 19.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic的IPO路演於11月12日持續，公司連結至發行網站。更新申報將825百萬股A類股（代號ANT）價格區間定為70至78美元，完全稀釋估值最高約1.4兆美元，募資最高約640億美元，另加Google、Nvidia等晶片/雲端夥伴約260億美元同步私人配售；預期約11月19日開始交易。
items_flat.analysis_en: The large raise and supplier participation underscore AI capital intensity and circular financing risks; final pricing and post-listing performance will test whether revenue growth (reported ~$81B run-rate) can justify the valuation amid market scrutiny of AI spending.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 大規模募資與供應商參與凸顯AI資本密集與循環融資風險；最終定價與上市後表現將測試收入成長（報導約810億美元年化）能否在市場對AI支出的審視下支撐估值。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2 for cell-specific DNA variant prediction
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind發布AlphaGenome 2，預測細胞專屬DNA變異效應
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2 on Nov 11, a next-generation DNA sequence model that predicts how genetic variants affect specific human cell types and states, trained on over 100 million cell profiles. It identifies nearly twice as many gene-expression-changing variants as its predecessor and is available for non-commercial research via API (private preview for commercial).
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月11日宣布AlphaGenome 2，下一代DNA序列模型，能預測基因變異對特定人類細胞類型與狀態的影響，訓練自超過1億個細胞資料。它識別影響基因表達的變異數量幾乎是前代兩倍，現已透過API向非商業研究開放（商業研究私人預覽）。
items_flat.analysis_en: By moving from tissue averages to cell-type resolution and supporting on-the-fly conditioning from new single-cell data, AlphaGenome 2 could accelerate variant-to-mechanism research in disease, though clinical translation remains distant and non-commercial access limits immediate commercial uptake.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 從組織平均轉向細胞類型解析，並支援新單細胞資料即時條件化，AlphaGenome 2有望加速疾病中變異至機制的研究，但臨床轉化仍遙遠，非商業存取也限制即時商業採用。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are announcing AlphaGenome 2, our next-generation model that predicts how DNA sequences and their variations impact specific human cell types, giving scientists a powerful new tool to uncover the cellular drivers of disease.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布AlphaGenome 2，我們的下一代模型，能預測DNA序列及其變異如何影響特定人類細胞類型，為科學家提供強大新工具，以揭示疾病的細胞驅動因素。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini Decisions API powered by Gemini Decision 1
items_flat.title_zh: Google推出由Gemini Decision 1驅動的Gemini Decisions API
items_flat.summary_en: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API on Nov 11, powered by the new Gemini Decision 1 model. It evaluates up to 1,000 yes/no, choice or rubric questions against one multimodal input (text, image, audio, video, PDF) in a single fast pass, returning probabilities and confidence scores at $0.10 per million input tokens with zero output-token charges and 150-250 ms latency.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google於11月11日推出Gemini Decisions API，由新模型Gemini Decision 1驅動。它能針對單一多模態輸入（文字、影像、音訊、影片、PDF）在單次快速通過中評估最多1000個是非、選擇或評分問題，回傳機率與信心分數，每百萬輸入token僅0.10美元且輸出token免費，延遲150-250毫秒。
items_flat.analysis_en: Purpose-built for routing, policy checks and grading without full generation, the API could cut latency and cost for agent control planes, but its advantage depends on calibration quality in real production workloads versus general models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 專為路由、政策檢查與評分設計而無需完整生成，此API可降低代理控制平面的延遲與成本，但其優勢取決於真實生產工作負載中的校準品質，相較一般模型如何。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model... returning probabilities and confidence scores in 150-250 ms end-to-end latency at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output tokens billed.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Decisions API，一個由新Gemini Decision 1模型驅動的快速閉集決策新端點……以150-250毫秒端到端延遲回傳機率與信心分數，每百萬輸入token 0.10美元且輸出token不計費。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol implementation
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind的AlphaProof Code正式驗證Signal協議實作
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaProof Code on Nov 10, an agentic framework that guided AI agents (powered by Gemini Carbon) to generate over six million lines of Lean proofs formally verifying key security properties of the actual compiled Signal protocol code in four weeks—the first time AI has verified a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月10日宣布AlphaProof Code，一種代理框架，引導由Gemini Carbon驅動的AI代理在四週內生成超過六百萬行Lean證明，正式驗證實際編譯的Signal協議程式碼關鍵安全屬性——這是首次AI以如此深度驗證廣泛部署的加密協議。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bridging design-to-implementation verification with AI agents marks a practical advance for high-assurance software, potentially scalable to other critical systems, though human expert oversight and the open-sourced artifacts’ real-world reuse remain key open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 以AI代理橋接設計至實作驗證，標誌高保證軟體的實用進展，可能擴展至其他關鍵系統，但人類專家監督與開源工件的真實世界再利用仍是關鍵開放問題。
items_flat.quote: This breakthrough discovery was made using AlphaProof Code, a novel agentic framework for formal verification at unprecedented depth... Our work marks the first time AI has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth.
items_flat.quote_zh: 此突破發現使用AlphaProof Code，一種前所未有深度的新型代理形式驗證框架……我們的工作標誌首次使用AI以如此深度正式驗證廣泛部署的加密協議。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for faster real-world dexterity
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，加速真實世界靈巧度
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5 on Nov 10, its most capable vision-language-action model, improving skill breadth, learning speed, reliability (96% success in a Mercedes-Benz Apptronik Apollo pilot) and safety steerability. It is rolling out to robotics partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月10日發布Gemini Robotics 2.5，其最強視覺-語言-行動模型，提升技能廣度、學習速度、可靠性（Mercedes-Benz Apptronik Apollo試點96%成功率）與安全可控性。現正向機器人合作夥伴推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Demonstrated factory success and safety improvements advance physical AI practicality, yet partner-only rollout and the gap to widespread deployment leave the timeline for everyday robotics uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 展示的工廠成功與安全改進推進物理AI實用性，但僅限合作夥伴推出及至廣泛部署的差距，使日常機器人時程仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date. Gemini Robotics 2.5 increases both the breadth of skills a robot can learn and the speed at which it can acquire them.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，迄今最強的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型。Gemini Robotics 2.5提升機器人能學習的技能廣度與習得速度。
